scope: Fixed host ownership, source-level work, existing host stack reports and persistence for the first autonomous bounded learner. No new learning, test execution, firmware qualification or full host process peak measurement.

provenance.platform: Linux x86_64; double 8 B, pointer 8 B
provenance.compiler: cc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04) 13.3.0; inherited existing host build record
provenance.stack_flags: -Iinclude -std=c99 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -fstack-usage for archived online reports; preserved model report uses the same optimization/ABI without -Werror.
methods: Earlier sizeof-only C probe; no inference execution.

Inspect frozen host executable with nm and size; these commands do not execute the estimator.

owned_objects_bytes.scope: All listed host driver objects have static storage and are disjoint. The workspace includes the prospective state used both for prediction and transactional restore. The query result is included simultaneously; no lifetime-overlay reduction was assumed.
owned_objects_bytes.trajectory_dependence: All dimensions and object sizes are fixed. No raw-sample journal, cached likelihood rows, factor bank growing with age, heap allocation or history-length loop in the inference core.

readonly_configuration.host_placement: nm reports lower and upper in read-only storage. The checkpoint magic may be folded into compiler constants; do not add its logical 8 B again to measured .rodata.
readonly_configuration.other_constants: Math constants, status/format strings, code and host link tables are additional; whole-host ELF section inventory is separate.
readonly_configuration.target_rule: Readonly arrays require explicit flash/SRAM placement in a target linker map. If both support arrays are copied into SRAM, add 256 B to the owned RAM subtotal. Custom OCV tables would be additional; this candidate uses the built-in illustrative OCV with no backing table.

stack.interpretation: Reviewed source call-chain sums deliberately retain small helper/tail-call frames that may be inlined or eliminated. Inlined locals are already inside reported caller frames. The 2632 B alternative sums all mutually exclusive new function frames plus the one reached model frame; it is a deliberately loose own-source inventory, not a simultaneous measured stack peak. No recursion or runtime-sized automatic arrays in the reviewed own source.
stack.exclusions: Library and system-call wrappers, libm/libc formatting and parsing, external callers, startup, interrupts and target ABI/compiler effects are excluded. No complete machine call-graph or full runtime stack proof.

partial_subtotals_bytes.notes: These are alternative partial scopes, not addends. The named objects are globals, so adding their own-source stack frames does not double count them. Runtime/library stack and allocations, remaining link sections and target-specific costs are still excluded. None is a complete 10240 B subsystem qualification.

persistence.restore_candidate: Uses the existing 2408 B workspace.candidate; already included in the 2920 B workspace. No second state allocation beyond that workspace.
persistence.stdio_buffer: Reuses the existing 128 B observation_gradient vector for save or restore; no concurrent ingestion/correction during persistence.
persistence.temporary_filename_scope: Already inside the measured 656 B save frame. Do not add separately.
persistence.field_codec_buffers: Fixed 4/8-byte automatic field buffers are inside reported helper/caller frames; no whole-file staging.
persistence.external_storage_scope: One current and one temporary checkpoint can coexist while replacing a file. 4880 B is two record payloads on persistent storage, excluding filesystem metadata and other retained archives; it is not SRAM.
persistence.unqualified: Host FILE objects, fdopen/fopen/mkstemp/stdio internals and filesystem caches may allocate. Directory power-loss durability, MCU flash erase/program staging, wear handling and failure recovery require separate target accounting.

host_executable.bss_difference: 128 B comprises 17 B of named stdout/stderr/runtime flags plus 111 B of layout/alignment. The separate .data section is 16 B of host runtime data. Other link/dynamic sections and shared libraries also consume memory.
host_executable.scope: Whole executable includes host CSV/JSON/persistence plumbing and legacy model object code. ELF .text/.rodata sizes are host build sizes, not Cortex-M23 flash forecasts. This is not RSS or a complete host memory peak.

retained_history_M1.scope: Observed requested session-plus-fit ownership, not total process RSS or complete stack. Most storage is 640 B of cached design rows per sample, allowing historical nonlinear reevaluation; the belief mean itself is small. New online memory savings exchange exact retained-history access for a local sequential Gaussian approximation.

earlier_fixed_chart_compact.scope: Fixed-chart evidence/remainder subsystem with a different ownership and inference contract; not an autonomous broad-prior nonlinear learner and not complete firmware. It preserves conditional information within a declared chart rather than retaining raw nonlinear history. Do not infer equivalent accuracy, uncertainty guarantees or functionality from the similar byte count.

comparisons.new_candidate: 5848 B core and 7016 B fixed host objects include autonomous mean/factor learning and fixed complete persistence. Numerical quality, local covariance behavior and the new hard error limits are judged by the independent first falsification; memory eligibility does not establish estimation success.

fixed_work.prediction: A fixed state copy and sparse F*S update of five dynamic rows. Eleven static rows carry unchanged; no historical parameter relinearization.
fixed_work.voltage_update: Two 16x16 matrix-vector products, a 16-element innovation norm, fixed 16-coordinate domain checks and two 16x16 factor passes for validation/commit. Same gain scale in mean and Joseph-equivalent factor.
fixed_work.query: Sixteen 16-element row norms plus fixed scalar transforms and status checks.
fixed_work.persistence: Fixed 2440-byte canonical record with bounded field loops; host I/O latency is not bounded by source loop lengths.
fixed_work.scope: Source-level O(16 squared) per observation and constant storage. No per-sample QR, optimizer, raw-history replay or age-dependent loop. This is not cycle, worst-case execution time, energy or M23 throughput measurement.

excluded_or_unresolved: libm/libc internals and complete caller/library/system stack; host FILE objects, allocator metadata/fragmentation, stdout/stderr buffers, process mappings and RSS.
Acquisition ring buffers/DMA/interrupt state, sensor/calibration/configuration storage, output queues and task scheduling for actual hardware.
Target compiler/ABI/linker placement, software binary64 arithmetic cost, exact SRAM/flash layout, interrupt nesting and worst-case 35 Hz deadline.
Persistent flash/NVM implementation, journaling/power-loss protocol and wear; the host filesystem codec is not a target flash port.
All-prefix numerical stability, factor underflow/cancellation, counter and elapsed-time longevity, local-Gaussian consistency, hard accuracy guarantees and validated uncertainty coverage.
Support arrays in RAM if target placement requires it; custom OCV tables and other immutable model/calibration data.
Python experiment orchestration, trace files, scoring/truth arrays, plots and logs are host research artifacts outside the per-estimator storage scope.
